meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描你的代码项目,找出没有被用到的变量、导入、函数、文件等死代码。它会先验证这些代码确实没被引用,再派多个后台代理并行删除,每删一批单独提交一次,最后自动跑类型检查、测试和构建来确认没问题。
howto.when: 当你说出“remove dead code”“dead code”“cleanup”等清理类关键词时,它会开始扫描项目。

say.text: 把项目里没用的代码清理掉
say.note: 触发全项目扫描并删除死代码。

say.text: 清理 src 目录下的死代码
say.note: 扫描范围限定在该目录。

say.text: 移除这个文件里未使用的导入
say.note: 只检查并清理指定文件。

howto.what_en: Scans project for unused variables/imports/params/types/orphaned files. Verifies via LSP, then parallel agents remove them in atomic commits. Ends with typecheck, tests, build.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like “remove dead code”, “dead code”, “cleanup”, or “remove unused”.

say_en.text: Clean up the unused code in this project
say_en.note: Triggers a full scan and removal.

say_en.text: Remove dead code from the src directory
say_en.note: Scopes the scan to that directory.

say_en.text: Find unused imports in this file
